verdict.rationale: DBOS ships official Python and TypeScript SDKs with extensive first-party docs, plus AI-native integrations (OpenAI Agents SDK drop-in runner, Vercel AI SDK, MCP server, DBOSClient) that let developers build agents directly against the library's APIs, corroborated by a community user praising the Python SDK's ergonomics. Missing for 10: broader language SDK coverage (a complaint notes no .NET support) and independent hands-on validation of the AI-specific integrations beyond docs.
